summary: Iter 156: Scaffolding Inventory & Delivery Challan Center — comprehensive backend + frontend testing. 23/23 pytest cases passed on /api/scaffolding/* covering the full flow (item create with auto SCF-#### code, locations, opening-stock, stock-matrix with in_transit, transfer create + same/insufficient-stock 400 guards + PM 403 approve gating, admin approve, over-qty challan 400, multi-challan partial→dispatched, PDF, receive partial→completed, exports xlsx/pdf, migrate-main-store). UI verified: /app/scaffolding loads, all 4 tabs (scaf-tab-stock/transfers/challans/items), 6 KPIs, sidebar nav-scaffolding, item creation toast, opening/adjust stock dialog, new-transfer dialog with all sub testids (scaf-transfer-from/to, scaf-line-item-0/qty-0, scaf-add-line, scaf-transfer-submit), challans list with PDF buttons. Regression pages /store-transactions, /ops/requests, /inventory-intel all return 200.

issues: 'Need By' field uses browser-default mm/dd/yyyy date picker instead of shadcn Calendar component (inconsistent with rest of ERP).

From/To Location and Item selects are native <select> — hydration warning in console ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>'), likely coming from a nested rendering in the item option label; consider switching to shadcn Select or trimming children.
When a toast appears in the top-right ('Item SCF-#### created'), it overlaps the top-right notification badge briefly — minor z-index/overlay observation.

action_items: Consider replacing native <select> in transfer dialog with shadcn Select to eliminate hydration warning about <span> child of <option>.
Replace native date input with shadcn Calendar/Popover for consistency.
Existing pre-seeded duplicate 'TEST Site Store A' stores from prior iterations noted (per main agent context) — not a bug, but consider a cleanup pass.
critical_code_review_comments: scaffolding_router.py is 459 lines, single-file router — approaching size limit but still manageable; splitting into items/transfers/challans sub-modules would improve maintainability if grown further.

Stock deduction and challan write are not inside a transaction — concurrent challans on same transfer could race; consider using MongoDB transactions or an optimistic lock on transfer.lines[].dispatched.

migrate-main-store role check happens AFTER require_permission — if a store_incharge (write access but not in APPROVE_ROLES) hits it, they get 403 correctly, but log/audit trail could benefit from an explicit 'attempted' entry.
receive_challan silently ignores if transfer doc missing (tr is None) — should probably 500/warn since it indicates data corruption.
PDF generator uses raw HTML string interpolation via _esc — verified _esc handles it. No SQL/NoSQL injection surfaces spotted.
